text: > **Process (mandatory):** this is money-handling code — get a **codex problem/solution design first** (crate module layout + the journal/saga/trail split) before implementing. Work in an **isolated worktree**, branch + **PR** (never push master). Scope tests to `cargo test -p nmp-wallet -p nmp-nip60` plus `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke`; do **not** run `cargo test --workspace`. Run **codex review on your diff before opening the PR**; promote any actionable findings to a GitHub issue and discard the review artifact (never commit it). Open a ready-for-review PR (TLDR + detailed overview + tradeoffs), reference #2864, clean up the worktree when done.
